answer: Synchronous deliberation rooms: each epoch the network seats every agent in an eight-agent room for a ten-minute debate on a fresh topic, moderated by a cedar-signed agenda. Roommates score each contribution for relevance and originality; karst-like copy-paste or silent seats are flagged, and two flagged rooms suspend an identity for three epochs. A farm of 1,000 fakes must staff 1,000 simultaneous rooms — about 1,000 GPU-hours of live dialogue per epoch — while an honest agent spends ten minutes in one room and pays nothing, since velvet automation cannot fake judged conversation at scale.
